notes: INSIDE half of the Gauntling Tesla Picket: two big copper-wound coils side by side with a ball-electrode gap that arcs on the loop, a patched hatch, power coupling and five copper coils. damaged: a coil is scorched and arcs to the casing; disabled: both coils unwound. The rotating head gauntling_tesla_picket_barrel swivels in the ring: a tall copper-wound Tesla coil topped with a steel ball, arcs crawling off it, and a lamp eye; fire: forked lightning from the ball.
